sections.shortTitle: Sindh Small Industries Corporation Amendment Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1990
ACT I OF 1990
SINDH SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend the Sindh Small
Industries Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th January, 1990]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/89, dated
8-1-1990.---The Sindh Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 1989
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th November, 1989
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 21st December, 1989 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act of XXVI of 1972

ACT I OF 1990
ACT I OF 1990
SINDH SMALL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend the Sindh Small
Industries Corporation Act, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 8th January, 1990]
No. PAS/Legis-B-12/89, dated
8-1-1990.---The Sindh Small Industries Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 1989
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 29th November, 1989
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 21st December, 1989 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 5 of Sindh Act of XXVI of 1972.--In the
Sindh Small Industries Corporation Act, 1972, in section S, for subsection (1),
the following shall be substituted.
(1) The Board shall consist of
the following:--
(i)
Minister for Industries, Government
of Sindh;
Chairman.
(ii)
Secretary, Industries and
Mineral Development Department, ,Govern ment of Sindh or his nominee not
below BS-19 Officer;
Member.
(iii)
Secretary, Finance Department,
Government of Sindh or his
nominee
not below the rank of
Additional
Secretary;
Member.
(iv)
One representative of the
planning
and Development Department not
below BS-19 Officer; .
Member.
(v)
Four Members of the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh elected by
the
Assembly, one from each Revenue
Division;
Member.
(vi)
Four persons domiciled in Sindh
appointed by Government one from each Revenue Division on the recommendation
of the Chairman for a term of three years, and may be appointed, thereafter for not more than
one term of three years;
Member.
(vii)
One representative each from
the Industrial Development Bank of Pakistan, the Export Promotion Bureau,
Government of Pakistan, and the Trading Corporation of Pakistan;
Member.
(viii)
Two members of the Federation
of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry representing the Province of Sindh;
Member.
(ix)
One representative of All
Pakistan Women's Association dealing with industrial sector;
Member.
(x)
Managing Director, Sindh Small
Industries Corporation.
Member/
Secretary.
